title: Walking Robot Simulation
description: Simulate a robot moving on a 2D plane with obstacles, returning the maximum squared Euclidean distance from the origin.
pseudocode:
1. directions = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [0, -1], [-1, 0]]
2. x = y = d = 0
3. for cmd in commands:
4.   if cmd == -1: d = (d + 1) % 4
5.   elif cmd == -2: d = (d + 3) % 4
6.   else:
7.     for _ in range(cmd):
8.       nx, ny = x + directions[d][0], y + directions[d][1]
9.       if (nx, ny) not in obstacles: x, y = nx, ny

steps.note: Initialize directions: North, East, South, West
